propositions: clarity_check returns verdict=fail with score>=threshold and no reason field when structural floor fails (plain-bullet ACs yield empty ac_items making floor.passes False)
The verdict is computed as a conjunction (score>=threshold AND floor.passes) but only the score half is returned in the output dict
A pass verdict returns the unchanged shape {score, verdict, threshold} with no reason field, preserving backward compatibility
A fail verdict must carry an additive reason field naming the failing condition (score floor or specific structural defect like empty AC item or unresolved sentinel with line)
The fix adds reason to clarity_result.schema.json, ClarityResult TypedDict, and ClarityResultOut without breaking existing consumers or exact-shape assertions
The merged fix (commit 9c6dcfda7932) makes the structural-floor cause discoverable by returning reason on all fail paths
